decisions.reason: The product stayed on the website and has a quantified customer benefit of over €600,000 saved per year, which for a mature German machinery maker is a strong signal to continue marketing it.
A dedicated product page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests ongoing commercial support, and mobile slow-speed shredders fit well with a recycling-equipment portfolio.
The concept remained visible in 2024 with a named customer reference and quantified savings, indicating successful market validation and low likelihood of withdrawal.
Although newly launched in 2024 and still early in its market life, its own page and close fit to the firm's core shredding business make continuation more likely than discontinuation.
As a 2024 launch without published results yet, it carries more uncertainty, but a dedicated page and clear adjacency to the firm's mobile screening range argue for keeping it on the market.
